headline: Digital Growth Systems | SEO & Conversion Strategy | AI Development
headline_rationale: Redis seeks a builder for website, search, conversion, measurement and AI workflows. Master supports technical websites, SEO consulting, experiments and marketing application development; do not invent agent-led account creation, Redis expertise or AEO/GEO results.
summary: Digital growth practitioner who combines website development, search analysis and conversion measurement. Built a headless React/Next.js commerce site with Shopify and GraphQL integrations, and developed an AI-assisted marketing command center connecting Google Ads, GA4 and Search Console evidence to dashboards, audits and recommendations. Experience in SEO consulting, content strategy, funnel experiments and cross-channel reporting supports connected digital journeys. Adds team leadership and agency evaluation experience for prioritizing technical work and translating performance findings into clear business decisions.
factual_review: Read exact Redis Lead Growth Marketing job. Current master E001/E044/E114/E006/E009/E093/E011 and marketing command center project directly support summary. No claims of Redis product proficiency, developer SaaS tenure, agent signup flows, AEO/GEO program ownership or citation growth.
tools_rationale: Supported search, conversion, analytical and AI development tools appropriate to a technical digital growth function.
